theme.description: Premium laptop e-commerce blending Apple's refined minimalism with Asus ROG's high-performance neon aesthetics. Dark mode dominant with striking emerald/neon green accents.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grid for categories and features. Asymmetrical layouts for marketing sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for breathing room.

surfaces_and_components.nav_header: Crystal glassmorphism: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. Do not use fully transparent.
surfaces_and_components.product_card: Solid dark surface (#0F0F0F) with 1px border-white/5, rounded-2xl. Hover state: border-white/20, subtle green glow drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,102,0.1)], transform -translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300.

buttons.primary: bg-[#00FF66] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#00CC52] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00FF66] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:border-[#00FF66] hover:text-[#00FF66] transition-colors

surfaces_and_components.forms: Use Shadcn components heavily customized: Inputs use bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 text-white focus:border-[#00FF66] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00FF66] rounded-xl. Remove default Shadcn blue rings.
surfaces_and_components.badges: bg-[#00FF66]/10 text-[#00FF66] border border-[#00FF66]/20 px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded-full font-medium tracking-wide

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All cards and buttons must have smooth 0.3s ease transitions. Laptops in cards should slightly scale up on hover (scale-105).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and subtle slide up using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion to reveal sections on scroll (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Neon border tracing on premium featured product cards on hover (Aceternity style).

testing_rules.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, product cards) must have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='product-card-123', data-testid='login-submit-button').

homepage.hero: Cinematic dark section. Split layout or full width. Large 3D laptop render (use hero_laptop_neon image). Neon green accent text for key value props. Heavy glassmorphism nav.
homepage.brand_strip: Slow marquee (react-fast-marquee) of partner logos (Intel, Nvidia, Asus, Apple) in low opacity zinc-600 with large tracking.
homepage.featured_products: Bento grid of premium laptops. The primary product takes up col-span-2 row-span-2.
homepage.deal_of_the_day: Asymmetrical split layout: left side large laptop image with neon glowing background, right side specs, countdown, and glowing Add to Cart button.
homepage.testimonials: Glassmorphism cards with subtle border-white/10, layered on a dark textural background.

product_listing.layout: CSS Grid layout. Sidebar filters on left (sticky, col-span-1), product grid on right (col-span-3).
product_listing.filters: Brand, Category, Price Range. Active filter states use #00FF66 text and borders.

product_detail.layout: Split screen on desktop. Sticky left gallery (min-h-[60vh]), right side scrolling details with generous p-12 padding.
product_detail.gallery: Large hero image, thumbnails below. Subtle dark vignette around images.
product_detail.specs: Clean bento-style grid for specs, parsing JSON beautifully into individual cards (CPU, RAM, GPU) with small Phosphor icons.
product_detail.actions: Massive primary neon green 'Add to Cart' button. 'Add to Wishlist' secondary icon button.
product_detail.reviews: Clean list layout with star ratings in #00FF66.

cart_checkout.cart: Drawer or dedicated page. Dark minimal line items, neon green total highlight.
cart_checkout.checkout: Clean single-page form or multi-step. COD and VNPAY selection as premium radio cards (border-white/10, selected state border-[#00FF66]).

auth.layout: Split screen: left side atmospheric dark tech image, right side glassmorphic login/register form.
auth.form: Customized Shadcn forms, solid dark inputs, green primary CTA.

profile_orders.layout: Sidebar navigation (Profile, Orders, Addresses). Main content area with flat dark cards.
profile_orders.orders: List of past orders with status badges (Green for delivered, Zinc for processing).

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these exact image URLs in the components and seed data. DO NOT USE placeholders like via.placeholder.com. Ensure images fit within the high-contrast dark theme.
